hero.subtitle: The editor that thinks with you — not just for you.

features.heading: Everything you need to write
features.subheading: AI-powered features built into every part of the editor.

aiPartner.title: Your AI writing partner
aiPartner.description: Chat with AI about your document. Get intelligent suggestions, fix grammar, rewrite paragraphs, and brainstorm ideas — all within a contextual conversation that understands your content.

intelligentAssist.title: Write with intelligent assistance
intelligentAssist.description: AI autocomplete suggests text as you type. Select any text to access formatting and AI tools from the bubble toolbar. Use slash commands to quickly insert headings, lists, code blocks, and more.

reviewChanges.title: Review AI changes with confidence
reviewChanges.description: Every AI edit appears as an inline diff. Review additions and deletions side by side, then accept or reject changes with a single click. You stay in full control of your document.

groundResearch.title: Ground AI in your research
groundResearch.description: Upload reference documents, papers, and notes to your knowledge base. The AI cites your sources when answering questions and suggests content grounded in your research materials.

askKB.title: Ask your knowledge base anything
askKB.description: The KB Agent searches across all your uploaded documents, reads relevant sections, and synthesizes answers with source citations and relevance scores. Ask follow-up questions for deeper exploration.

present.title: Present your writing full-screen
present.description: Turn any document into a polished slideshow with a single click. Navigate slides with keyboard shortcuts or click navigation, with automatic slide splitting by headings.

semanticSearch.title: Search by meaning, not just keywords
semanticSearch.description: AI-powered semantic search understands the meaning behind your query. Find relevant passages even when they don't contain exact keyword matches, with relevance scores for each result.

writingReview.title: AI-powered writing review
writingReview.description: Get comprehensive feedback on grammar, clarity, tone, and engagement. Review categorized suggestions one by one or accept them all at once. Every suggestion shows the original text, the improvement, and why.

thinkingMode.title: AI that thinks before it answers
thinkingMode.description: For complex questions, the AI enters thinking mode — reasoning step by step before responding. Watch the thought process unfold in real time, then get a deeper, more accurate answer.

inlineComments.title: Collaborate with inline comments
inlineComments.description: Highlight any text to start a conversation. Leave comments, reply in threads, and resolve discussions when done. Every comment stays anchored to the exact passage it references.

databaseBlocks.title: Structured data, right inside your docs
databaseBlocks.description: Add databases to any page with table, board, gallery, and list views. Define custom properties, filter and sort your data, and export to CSV — all without leaving the editor.

dataAnalysis.title: Drop a CSV, get instant insights
dataAnalysis.description: Upload any data file and let AI do the heavy lifting. It reads your data, spots trends, and generates visualizations — turning raw spreadsheets into actionable insights in seconds.

workflow.heading: One workspace, every workflow
workflow.subheading: Write, research, and present — all from the same document.

ctaSection.heading: Try doXmind today
ctaSection.subheading: Start writing with AI for free. No credit card required.
